nodes.label: Howard Combo Organ
nodes.copy:
Every Howard combo organ we restore for sale goes through the same meticulous process we're known for, with dozens of hours devoted to bringing each instrument to exceptional playing condition. We prioritize period-correct vintage components whenever possible, and turn to the best available reproduction parts when originals are no longer viable — always working to preserve the instrument's original character and tone. The result is an organ that plays and sounds better than it likely has in decades.

The Howard was sold by the D.H. Baldwin Company (the "Howard" name comes from founder Dwight Hamilton Baldwin's middle name) but built in Italy by GEM — the same manufacturer behind the Vox Jaguar, whose design was based directly on the Howard. The electronics between the two are nearly identical, with largely interchangeable circuit cards. Only around 500 Howards were ever imported into the US, making them one of the rarer combo organs from this era. They're known for a harsher, raunchier, more raw-edged voice than most of their contemporaries — a gritty, fuzzy character that's very much part of the appeal. The Howard is also unusual among combo organs for offering optional leg extensions, which raise the organ about 5 inches for a more standard console-height setup.

Features:
- Cleaned, Lubricated & Restored Key Contacts and Switches
- New Electrolytic Capacitors

- CEPCo's Expert Tuning & Voicing Setup
